verses.text: When you have entered the land the LORD your God is giving you as your own, and you have taken it over and settled in it,

take some of the first part of all the crops you harvest from the land the LORD your God is giving you. Put them in a basket, and go to the place the LORD your God will choose as the place where his name will live.
Go to the priest who is in office at that time and say to him, "I declare today to the LORD your God that I have come into the land the LORD promised our ancestors he would give us."
The priest will take the basket from your hands and set it down in front of the altar of the LORD your God.

Then you must say in the presence of the LORD your God: "My ancestor was a wandering Aramean, close to dying. He went down to Egypt with only a few people and lived there. There he became a great nation, strong and with many people.
But the Egyptians treated us badly and made us suffer. They forced us to do hard work as slaves.
Then we cried out to the LORD, the God of our ancestors. The LORD heard our voice and saw our suffering, our hard work, and how we were being crushed.
So the LORD brought us out of Egypt with his mighty hand and powerful arm, with terrifying power, and with miracles and wonders.
He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
And now, LORD, I have brought the first part of the crops from the land you have given me." Then set the basket down in front of the LORD your God and bow down to worship before him.
Then you, the Levites, and the foreigners living among you must celebrate all the good things the LORD your God has given to you and your family.

In the third year, the year of the tenth parts, when you have finished setting aside a tenth of all your crops, give it to the Levites, the foreigners, the orphans, and the widows, so that they may eat in your towns and be full.

Then say to the LORD your God: "I have taken from my house the holy portion and given it to the Levites, the foreigners, the orphans, and the widows, just as you commanded me. I have not turned away from your commands or forgotten any of them.

I have not eaten any of it while I was mourning. I have not removed any of it while I was unclean, and I have not offered any of it to the dead. I have obeyed the LORD my God. I have done everything you commanded me.
Look down from heaven, your holy home, and bless your people Israel and the land you have given us, as you promised our ancestors, a land flowing with milk and honey."
Today the LORD your God commands you to obey these rules and laws. Be careful to obey them with all your heart and all your soul.
Today you have declared that the LORD is your God, and that you will live the way he wants, keep his rules, commands, and laws, and obey him.
And today the LORD has declared that you are his people, his own special treasure, as he promised, and that you must keep all his commands.
He will set you high above all the nations he has made, and give you praise, fame, and honour. You will be a people set apart as holy to the LORD your God, as he promised.
